class.name: DSRequest
class.brief_description: Encapsulates a single DirectStorage read request.
class.description: [DSRequest] contains the source file path, byte offset, read size, cancellation tag, compression format, destination target (CPU memory buffer, GPU buffer, or GPU texture), and execution status for one DirectStorage or software-fallback read. For [constant COMPRESSION_GDEFLATE], [member size] is the compressed byte count and [member uncompressed_size] is the required destination size.

method.name: get_cancellation_tag
method.description: Returns the tag used to cancel this request with [method DSContext.cancel_requests_with_tag].

method.name: get_compression_format
method.description: Returns the compression format expected for the source bytes.

method.name: get_destination_buffer
method.description: Returns the destination bytes. After completion, this contains the raw or decompressed request output when targeting system memory.

method.name: get_destination_resource
method.description: Returns the [RID] of the target GPU buffer or GPU texture resource when [member destination_type] is [constant DESTINATION_GPU_BUFFER] or [constant DESTINATION_GPU_TEXTURE].

method.name: get_destination_type
method.description: Returns the destination target type ([constant DESTINATION_MEMORY], [constant DESTINATION_GPU_BUFFER], or [constant DESTINATION_GPU_TEXTURE]).

method.name: get_error_message
method.description: Returns the diagnostic message recorded when the request fails, or an empty string when no error was recorded.

method.name: get_file_path
method.description: Returns the source file path.

method.name: get_first_subresource
method.description: Returns the zero-based index of the first subresource (mip level or array layer) targeted in a GPU texture destination request.

method.name: get_offset
method.description: Returns the byte offset at which the file read starts.

method.name: get_priority
method.description: Returns the queue priority level of this request ([constant PRIORITY_LOW], [constant PRIORITY_NORMAL], or [constant PRIORITY_HIGH]).

method.name: get_size
method.description: Returns the number of source bytes to read. For GDeflate, this is the compressed size.

method.name: get_status
method.description: Returns the current request status.

method.name: get_subresource_count
method.description: Returns the number of consecutive subresources (mip levels or array layers) written in a GPU texture destination request.

method.name: get_texture_format
method.description: Returns the native driver texture data format identifier used for destination validation.

method.name: get_texture_layout
method.description: Returns the native driver texture layout identifier used for destination validation.

method.name: get_uncompressed_size
method.description: Returns the expected output size in bytes for a compressed request.

method.name: set_cancellation_tag
method.description: Sets the cancellation tag used by [method DSContext.cancel_requests_with_tag].

method.name: set_compression_format
method.description: Sets whether the source data is raw or GDeflate-compressed.

method.name: set_destination_buffer
method.description: Sets the destination buffer. Its size must be large enough for the request output before enqueueing.

method.name: set_destination_resource
method.description: Sets the target GPU buffer or texture [RID] when [member destination_type] is [constant DESTINATION_GPU_BUFFER] or [constant DESTINATION_GPU_TEXTURE].

method.name: set_destination_type
method.description: Sets the destination target type ([constant DESTINATION_MEMORY], [constant DESTINATION_GPU_BUFFER], or [constant DESTINATION_GPU_TEXTURE]).

method.name: set_error_message
method.description: Sets the diagnostic message associated with a failed request.

method.name: set_file_path
method.description: Sets the source file path to read.

method.name: set_first_subresource
method.description: Sets the zero-based index of the first subresource (mip level or array layer) targeted in a GPU texture destination request.

method.name: set_offset
method.description: Sets the byte offset at which the file read starts.

method.name: set_priority
method.description: Sets the queue priority level of this request ([constant PRIORITY_LOW], [constant PRIORITY_NORMAL], or [constant PRIORITY_HIGH]).

method.name: set_size
method.description: Sets the number of source bytes to read.

method.name: set_status
method.description: Sets the request status. This is primarily used by the active backend; user code should normally only read [member status].

method.name: set_subresource_count
method.description: Sets the number of consecutive subresources written in a GPU texture destination request.

method.name: set_texture_format
method.description: Sets the native driver texture data format identifier for GPU destination compatibility validation.

method.name: set_texture_layout
method.description: Sets the native driver texture layout identifier for GPU destination compatibility validation.

method.name: set_uncompressed_size
method.description: Sets the expected decompressed output size in bytes.

members.member: An arbitrary [int] tag assigned to this request used for batch cancellation via [method DSContext.cancel_requests_with_tag].
The compression format of the source data ([code]COMPRESSION_NONE[/code] or [code]COMPRESSION_GDEFLATE[/code]).
The destination memory buffer where decompressed or raw uncompressed bytes are written when [member destination_type] is [constant DESTINATION_MEMORY].
The GPU buffer or texture resource [RID] when [member destination_type] is [constant DESTINATION_GPU_BUFFER] or [constant DESTINATION_GPU_TEXTURE].
The destination type where read data will be delivered ([constant DESTINATION_MEMORY], [constant DESTINATION_GPU_BUFFER], or [constant DESTINATION_GPU_TEXTURE]).
Error diagnostic string set if the request failed.
The file path on disk to read from.
The first subresource index (mip level or array layer) targeted in a GPU texture destination request.
The byte offset in the file to start reading from.
Queue priority level for this request ([constant PRIORITY_LOW], [constant PRIORITY_NORMAL], or [constant PRIORITY_HIGH]).
The number of bytes to read from the file (compressed size when using GDeflate).
The number of consecutive subresources written in a GPU texture destination request.
Expected native GPU driver texture format identifier for destination compatibility validation.
Expected native GPU driver texture layout identifier for destination compatibility validation.
The expected decompressed size in bytes for compressed requests.
The current status of this request ([code]STATUS_PENDING[/code], [code]STATUS_SUBMITTED[/code], [code]STATUS_COMPLETED[/code], or [code]STATUS_FAILED[/code]).

constants.constant: Request is created but has not been enqueued.
Request has been enqueued in the DirectStorage/fallback queue.
Request read and decompression has completed successfully.
Request failed during I/O read or decompression.
Data is compressed with GPUOpen/NVIDIA GDeflate tile format.
Destination is a CPU system memory buffer ([member destination_buffer]).
Destination is a GPU buffer identified by [member destination_resource].
Destination is a GPU texture identified by [member destination_resource].
Low queue priority for background asset streaming.
Normal queue priority for standard read requests.
High queue priority for urgent or blocking asset loads.
